turns.utterance: I want to order 1 kg mutton also, separate from my earlier chicken order
expected_response_constraints: Must allow a second order from the same customer
Must NOT merge with the existing chicken order
forbidden_behaviors: Do not reject because customer already has an order
Do not auto-merge with existing order without asking

turns.speaker: agent
turns.utterance: Sure! 1 kg mutton at Rs. 650/kg = Rs. 650. I note you have an existing order (ORD-20260801-030) for chicken. This will be a separate order. Shall I confirm?
expected_response_constraints: Must mention existing order for transparency

turns.speaker: caller
turns.utterance: Yes, confirm it separately
expected_response_constraints: Must not modify existing order ORD-20260801-030
forbidden_behaviors: Do not merge with existing order

notes: Tests that a customer can place multiple independent orders on the same day without them being auto-merged or rejected.

title: Cancellation releases reserved stock

turns.speaker: caller
turns.utterance: Please cancel my chicken order
expected_response_constraints: Must identify the caller's order (ORD-20260801-035) based on caller_phone
forbidden_behaviors: Do not cancel wrong order
Do not cancel other customer's order (ORD-20260801-036)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.utterance: I found your order ORD-20260801-035 for 5 kg chicken (Rs. 1,100). Are you sure you want to cancel it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.utterance: Yes cancel it
expected_response_constraints: reserved_qty must drop from 8 to 3 (releasing 5 from cancelled order)
Other order (ORD-20260801-036) reservations must remain intact
forbidden_behaviors: Do not release reservations from other orders
Do not modify on_hand_qty

turns.speaker: agent
turns.utterance: Your order ORD-20260801-035 has been cancelled. 5 kg chicken released back to available stock. Current availability: 7 kg.

notes: Tests that cancellation releases only the cancelled order's reservation (5 kg) while leaving other orders' reservations (3 kg) intact. reserved_qty goes from 8 to 3.

title: Walk-in sale exceeding available - should fail

turns.speaker: caller
turns.utterance: I sold 3 kg chicken to a walk-in customer just now
expected_response_constraints: Must reject or warn because available qty is only 1 kg (5 on_hand minus 4 reserved)
Walk-in sale of 3 kg would set on_hand to 2 which is less than reserved_qty of 4
This would break the invariant: on_hand_qty >= reserved_qty
Must present options to the owner
forbidden_behaviors: Do not allow on_hand to drop below reserved_qty
Do not silently break inventory invariant

turns.speaker: agent
turns.utterance:
I cannot process a 3 kg walk-in sale right now. You have 5 kg on hand but 4 kg is reserved for phone orders, leaving only 1 kg available for walk-in sales. Would you like to:
1. Record a 1 kg walk-in sale instead
2. Cancel some phone order reservations first to free up stock
3. Skip recording this walk-in sale
expected_response_constraints: Must show available for walk-in is 1 kg
forbidden_behaviors: Do not allow invariant violation
Do not silently deduct

notes: Tests that walk-in sales cannot reduce on_hand below reserved_qty, maintaining the inventory invariant on_hand_qty >= reserved_qty.

title: Stock enquiry for all products

Fish: 0 kg - out of stock at Rs. 350/kg

Do not show reserved qty to customer
Do not show on_hand qty directly - only available
